description: Northern Territory Mines is a dataset listed in Northern Territory Government open data portal (data.nt.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Mining and Energy. Northern Territory Mines is a subset of the Mineral Occurrences Database (MODAT). MODAT provides information on metalliferous and non- metalliferous mineral occurrences and deposits within the Northern Territory. The data is captured by geologists from company reports and/or field work, and is stored in a Microsoft Access2010 database. Coverage: Northern Territory. The portal files it under the publisher Mining and Energy. Its tags are Economy, Geoscientific Information. It offers 5 resource(s) in csv, html, kml, mapinfo tab, shp. The portal shows 2023-09-01 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-nt-government-open-data-portal.
